Good movement is observed from Abule Egba underneath Jubilee Bridge, proceeding towards Oja Oba, and continuing down to Charity Junction. Movement along Charity Road, connecting Social Club, Olayiwola Junction, and the Abbattoir is also good. 

A smooth flow of traffic is observed from Super inward to Ile Epo, extending down to Pleasure and back towards Abule Egba Jubilee via Ile Epo for the return journey. Similarly, the Lagos/Abeokuta Expressway, from Ahmadiyya through Ijaiye, Kola Alakuko, and down to Ajegunle, is experiencing free vehicular movement. 

The return journey on this expressway, from the Toll Gate through Amje, Moshalashi, Meiran Junction, Carso, and down to Awori U-turn, is also reporting good traffic flow.

No significant impediments to traffic have been reported. Our men are present at key locations ensuring ease of movement.
